description: Fontaines à boire (Marseille) - Gestion Ville de Marseille is a dataset listed in DATA Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Marseille. Fontaines d'eau potable installées dans les parcs et jardins de la Ville de Marseille, et gérées par la Ville de Marseille. Certaines fontaines peuvent être provisoirement hors service ou inaccessibles (travaux de réparation, actes de vandalisme, etc.). Coverage: Marseille. The portal files it under Service. Its keywords are fontaines à boire, fontaine. The portal shows 129 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-04-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ampmetropole-fr-portal.
